Game Overview

In Take only Banana, the core idea is straightforward: catch bananas and dodge falling apples in this fast-paced arcade challenge. Hone your reflexes and strategic thinking as you navigate cascading fruit. Easy to learn but hard to master, "Take Only Banana" promises thrilling gameplay where every move counts and speed is essential. Stay focused and have fun!
